message.abstract: <jats:p><p><em>Clustering</em><em> which is a </em><em>method to classify data easily </em><em>is used for</em><em> </em><em>a </em><em>purpose </em><em>of</em><em> look</em><em>ing</em><em> at the correlation </em><em>among</em><em> data attributes. Clustering is </em><em>also a </em><em>data point </em><em>grouping</em><em> based on similarity value to determine </em><em>the </em><em>cluster center. Affinity Propagation (AP) and Adaptive Affinity Propagation (Adaptive AP) are clustering algorithms that produce number of cluster, cluster members and exemplar of each cluster. T</em><em>his research</em><em> </em><em>is conducted to </em><em>find out </em><em>a </em><em>more effective algorithm when clustering data. </em><em>Besides, to know the correction offered by Adaptive AP Algorithm which is the developed form of AP Algorithm, the researcher implemented and tested both algorithms by using Matlab R2013a 8.10 with 250 data taken from students’ GPA and the distance from their houses to campus. The a</em><em>naly</em><em>sis of</em><em> </em><em>test result application from </em><em>both algorithms </em><em>shows that </em><em>the best </em><em>algorithm</em><em> is </em><em>Adaptive AP because it produces optimal clustering. Another result is no correlation between GPA and home distance.</em><em></em></p></jats:p>
title: Pengujian Algoritma Clustering Affinity Propagation dan Adaptive Affinity Propagation terhadap IPK dan Jarak Rumah
